name: grid
purpose: A heatmap of a list of numbers or a list of rows (logits, weights). The learner can raise or lower a cell.
binds: list of numbers or list of rows
keys: arrows or WASD move, + or E raise, − or Q lower, ⇧ for ten steps

bind.doc: the state key of the numbers

lo.doc: the value at the pale end of the ramp; the smallest value if left out

hi.doc: the value at the dark end of the ramp; the largest value if left out

gutter.doc: the width for the row names
